title: k-random-neighbors
summary: A research notebook implementing a Monte-Carlo-based classification method (a randomized alternative to k-nearest neighbors) using scattered data points, tested on the iris dataset. The gan.ipynb notebook uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with a Metadata object to fit per-class synthetic data and generate additional samples for augmentation.
evidence: src/gan.ipynb:93 'synthesizer = CTGANSynthesizer(metadata)' followed by synthesizer.fit(df_cls) and synthesizer.sample(num_rows=samples_per_class)
needs: unclear whether generated synthetic data is actually used downstream in the classification method or just exploratory
